x: A fast start saw Ron West in the lead round the Common. He was closely followed by Eric Hall and the constantly improving Stan Vickers who had changed from his usual claret and gold to those of the Stock Exchange for the afternoon.
Ron West, a second claim member who was walking in the handicap which was held in conjunction, walked an exceptionall good race to beat Eric for first place.

Ron West (a second claim member) had also put on a spurt to move up to third place, but later suffered disqualification. Ron West, our second claim member, had moved into the lead but was passed close home by Vic Stone who won in 3hrs. 41m. 46s. Bernard Eglington home on leave from Germany, walked strongly to finish 4th in 3.45.40.
